events.title: Welcome to the Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello everyone, The Steam Next Fest is finally here! We are JMP Games, a small indie team, and we are very happy to share our second game with you! We love creating experiences that help people unwind, and Train Goes Choo Choo is exactly that: a completely cozy, idle journey. The concept is simple. Just sit back, relax, and watch the train go by. We still have a lot of upgrades in mind before the final release, but we wanted to use the Next Fest to let you try the core loop of the game. events.summary: Starting October 19th for the Steam Next Fest, try our updated demo! Major performance upgrades, key improvements and an even more satisfying ride. Grab your ticket and enjoy the view!
